frequency_question: How often does a contested federal health agency nomination successfully secure a Senate floor confirmation vote resulting in approval within a tight legislative timeline?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet-level or major regulatory agency heads (FDA, CDC, Surgeon General, HHS) facing notable ideological or industry-related Senate opposition; excludes routine or uncontested confirmations.
provenance_note: 3 cases named, 4 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 3 named; focused specifically on FDA leadership confirmations due to high regulatory specificity.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-agency posts that do not reach full floor votes.
skeleton: Contested health agency nominations under divided or narrow-majority Senates
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 major recent contested votes
validity_reason: Valid through the current political administration and current Senate procedural norms regarding cloture and simple majorities for executive nominees.
